label: Light Bowgun
note: MHFU's Elemental Maniac LBG set stacks Element Attack Up (1.2x) with Auto-Reload, Evade +2, and Bullet Limit, while Attack Up boosts both the raw and elemental portions of elemental shots. Recoil Reduction, Reload Speed, and rapid-fire shot count (Bonus Shot in later games) are unmodeled; Attack Up is optional and not assumed here.
